summary: Verification-only frontend testing of imported 'Puzzle Gems' (Jewel Sort) Expo app. All 9 requested flows PASS. App compiles, Expo web preview loads cleanly, level select screen shows 'Tus niveles' with 10 level cards (level-1..level-10) and levels 2-10 locked initially. Level 1 opens with 5 tubes (tube-1..tube-5), valid move tube-1 -> tube-4 increments MOVIMIENTOS from 0 -> 1, invalid move tube-4 -> tube-2 (emerald on sapphire) is rejected (count stays 1 and selection clears after ~320ms), undo decrements back to 0, back-to-levels returns to level grid. Level 1 fully solved in 12/par-12 moves -> victory modal 'Nivel completado' + 'DESTELLO CONSEGUIDO' + 3-star brillo + Siguiente nivel. Progress persists in AsyncStorage (web localStorage): pill updates to 1/10, best '12 mov.' shown on level-1 card, level-2 unlocks (play icon) and opens 'Brillo cruzado'; all persisted after full page reload. Audio toggles toggle-music / toggle-sfx flip state correctly (aria-label swaps Silenciar<->Activar, icon glyph swaps musical-notes <-> musical-notes-outline, background class swaps active/inactive). No red-screen, no runtime errors, no 500s. Only web warnings are RN-Web style deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents, textShadow*) emitted by framework-level styles, not user bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' props deprecated (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents), 'textShadow*' props deprecated (use textShadow). These come from StyleSheet.create blocks across the UI (e.g. iconButton/statsRow/boardCard/completeSheet shadow* in app/index.tsx, and shadow usages in src/components/*). Non-blocking on native/iOS/Android, but noisy on web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:485, 496, 514, 537, 559 and src/components/LevelCard.tsx / Tube.tsx shadow styles.

action_items: No functional changes required - app imported and runs as-is per request. Optional (not blocking): migrate shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents style props to the newer boxShadow / textShadow / style.pointerEvents forms to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings when serving via web preview.
Optional UX note: 'Reiniciar' uses Alert.alert which is non-interactive on web (user already noted this).
critical_code_review_comments: Victory modal 'Siguiente nivel' passes goToLevels (function reference) instead of goToLevels() when activeLevelId === LEVELS.length - likely a no-op bug on level 10 completion. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:385. Not in scope to fix (verification-only), but worth flagging.

canMoveGem uses tubes[to]?.length >= TUBE_CAPACITY in a boolean short-circuit; if tubes[to] is undefined, the comparison yields false and we fall through - low risk because indices are bounded, but defensively could be tubes[to].length. Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/logic.ts:9.
